name: Violin of the Sea Temple
body:
Price 30,375 gp; Slot none CL 9th Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate enchantment and evocation

This violin is made of silver and decorated with lapis lazuli patterns in the form of whirlpools and waves. Up to three times per day as a standard action, you can play the violin to produce one of the following three effects. Each effect requires a successful Perform (string) skill check.

Aquatic Dissonance: You produce a single strident note that stuns all creatures in a 30-ft. radius for 1 minute (Fortitude saving throw to negate, DC 13)
Charm Sea Creatures: You may make friends with sea-dwelling creatures as if using charm person (Will saving throw to negate, DC 11).
Water Detonation: You can cause an explosion of waves duplicating the effects of a detonate (cold) spell (Reflex saving throw for half, DC 16)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 15,187 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells charm fey, detonate, sound burst
